headline: Woodhouse beats Joyce to win the Baltic Sea Darts Open in Kiel
standfirst: Luke Woodhouse won European Tour 8 with an 8-4 final win over Ryan Joyce, averaging 98.61 in the final.
body: Luke Woodhouse won the Baltic Sea Darts Open in Kiel, beating Ryan Joyce 8-4 in the final at the MERKUR Ostseehalle. Woodhouse saved his best average of the weekend, 98.61, for the final. Joyce averaged 94.46.
Woodhouse was rarely troubled on his way through the draw. He beat Andrew Gilding 6-3, Cameron Menzies 6-1, Jimmy van Schie 6-3 and Ricky Evans 7-2 to reach the final.
Joyce came through a close semi-final against Damon Heta 7-6 after a comfortable 6-1 quarter-final win over Dave Chisnall. Heta had knocked out Wessel Nijman 6-2 in the quarter-finals.

Menzies set the standard in the first round. He averaged 108.41 against Rob Cross and hit a 170 checkout, matched by William O'Connor against Cristo Reyes. Justin Hood averaged 103.38 against Max Hopp in the same round.
Kevin Doets hit 14 of the 181 maximums across the event, the most of any player. Evans and Van Schie hit 10 each.
